<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-0313-58-02" status="unreviewed">dang po 'i <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang</rs></note><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha 1</rs> na re shes bya'i tha snyad la blo'i yul rung gis shes bya'i tha snyad du mtshon pa'i
               <lb n="22a9"/>tshe mtshan gzhi dang mtshon bya ldog pa mtshungs | tshul l a la nyid kyis rtag kyi tha snyad du mtshon pa'i tshe mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid ldog pa mtshungs so | mngon byur gyi tha dad la myong ba'i tog bya bkag pas mngon gyur ma yi pa'i hasyad du mtshon pa'i tshe gzhi mtshon na po ldog pa 'gal ba yin | ba lang gi don ldog chos na tshang ba la
            
            <pb n="22b"/>
          
               <lb n="22b1"/>de nyid bkag pas ba lang gi mtshid ma yin par mtshon pa'i she | gzhi mtshan n2a po ldog pa 'gal ba yin ze | bra ni di dag rigs pa ma yin sbyod pa dang po yang gzhi mtshon r2g pa mtshungs mtshngs 'ra te mi mtshungs gzhan dogs pa'i blo la ltos pa'i shes ya'i tha ya tshan gnyi yin a rang doge a' bol tos pa shes bya'i ba
               <lb n="22b2"/>snyad mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir | | 2 la yang tshul 2 gyi bye brag mtshan gzhi yin la spyi mtshid yin pas mi mtshungs so | bna pa yang sngon po la ltos pa'i mo ng gyur gyi th snyad mtshan gzhi m non byur gyi tha snyad rang ldog la ltos pa'i de ma yin gyi tha snyad mtshon bya yin pas mi 'gal la | ba zhi pa yang log bhral la ltos pa'i ba lan gi don
               <lb n="22b3"/>ldog chos 3 mtshan gzhi chos 3 rang ldog la ltos nga'i ba lang gi don ldog chos 3 bkag pa mtshid yin pas 'gal ba meod dao || </seg></TEI>
